Hi Neha,

We need to initiate a formal erasure of all conversation artifacts associated with our FinServCo integration (account id: FS-2026-058). Specifically: prompts, model outputs, embeddings derived from customer data, runtime request logs, and transient KV/cache entries.

Legal has asked for confirmation that Redwood can:
- Remove prompts/outputs and make them unrecoverable from hosted storage and index snapshots
- Purge runtime logs and structured traces associated with our account for the specified date range (2025-01-01 -> 2026-09-01)
- Provide a signed attestation and run-id once the job completes, plus a CSV with before/after counts for record-keeping

Attached is the signed erasure request from Legal (FinServCo_ERASURE_REQUEST.pdf). Can you confirm scope and expected timeline? Also let us know whether Dedicated/Private artifacts (we run a dedicated tenant) require different procedures.

Thanks — Samantha

Subject: Re: Erasure request: conversation artifacts and runtime logs for FinServCo

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear scope and the signed request. We can proceed. High-level:

1) Scope confirmation (please reply if anything listed below should be excluded):
   - Prompts & generation outputs stored in hosted object stores and indexes (yes)
   - Embeddings and vector index snapshots derived from FinServCo content (yes)
   - Request/response runtime logs, structured traces, and any derived metrics (yes)
   - KV/cache entries (transient in-memory + persisted cache snapshots) (yes)
   - Backups & archive snapshots: we will purge application-level copies and index snapshots; legacy backups may have a short retention window described below

2) Timeline & procedure:
   - We require the signed erasure request (attached) and an authorized approver name (Legal confirms).
   - For Hosted accounts: standard erasure jobs complete within 72 hours after approval; we will provide a run-id and CSV with before/after object counts and a signed digest.
   - For Dedicated tenants (your deployment): we may need a short maintenance window (1–4 hours) to run agent-led sweeps of the dedicated storage and index services; expected total timeline 72–120 hours depending on snapshot retention.

3) Proof artifacts we will provide:
   - Erasure run id (format ERASE-YYYYMMDD-XXXX)
   - CSV: object list counts (before/after) and checksums; run log stub (erasure_run_log_*.csv)
   - Signed attestation PDF (signed by Redwood security)

4) Notes on backups & forensic copies:
   - Operational backups: there may be short-lived system backups that are rotated; we will purge index snapshots and request-level objects but some low-level backups could persist up to 7 days while rotation completes.
   - If your compliance regime requires absolute immediate wipe of all copies, we recommend scheduling a Dedicated maintenance window so we can control storage tiers directly.

Next steps: please confirm (a) authorized approver name for FinServCo Legal, and (b) whether you accept the 72–120 hour timeline. Once we have that, we will schedule the run and share the run-id.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Erasure request (FinServCo) — technical runbook

Thanks Rishi — technical runbook below. TL;DR: we can meet 72 hours for Hosted; Dedicated may extend to 5 days if index snapshots require offline compaction.

Runbook (high level):
1) Scope validation & authorization: verify FinServCo_ERASURE_REQUEST.pdf + authorized approver email.
2) Pre-run snapshot (read-only): capture object counts for prompts, outputs, embeddings, request logs, and index snapshot list. Store counts in secure audit bucket (immutable).
3) Erasure jobs (parallel where possible):
   - Object store sweep: identify and delete keys with account prefix FS-2026-058/generations/* and FS-2026-058/prompts/*
   - Vector index: remove doc vectors, rebuild index shards where needed, and delete index snapshots FS-2026-058-idx-*
   - Runtime logs & traces: run retention purge on structured traces; drop request-level logs older than retention window as requested (we will target full sweep for dates you specified)
   - KV/cache: clear persisted cache snapshots and rotate in-memory cache instances; KV encryption keys rotated after purge (to render stale cached blocks unusable)
4) Post-run verification: generate CSV (erasure_run_log_ERASE-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.csv) with before/after counts and content digests; sign digest with Redwood HSM-backed key.
5) Audit artifacts: place signed attestation in the customer's audit folder and provide link to the run in the console.

Important caveats:
- If FinServCo has any on-prem export copies (they control), Redwood cannot delete those.
- Backups: low-level system backups may require a short rotation period (up to 7 days) to fully propagate deletions. We will note this in the attestation.

Operational owners: infra_oncall (for maintenance), index-team (for shard rebuild), security-compliance (attestation).

I will schedule the run as soon as we get Legal's explicit approver and a confirmation of maintenance window for Dedicated. We will also generate an internal change ticket.

— Monica
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
